name: Wisconsin
summary_text: Assessed as comparatively protected (July 2026): largely refrains from targeting trans adults but does not specialise in protection; no state-specific finding beyond the shared tier evidence. Marginally above the national score 0.36.

sources.title: Anti-Trans National Legal Risk Assessment Map: July 2026
sources.claim_summary: Anti-trans legal risk assessment map, July 2026 update: classifies every US state by trans-related legal risk; Wisconsin sits in the 'Low-Risk States' tier — states that have 'largely refrained from targeting transgender adults' though they also 'haven't taken extraordinary steps to protect' them. The same update names four 'Do Not Travel' states (Idaho, Florida, Kansas, Texas), grades Michigan and Nevada as robust on non-discrimination but short on healthcare-equity and incarcerated-person protections, and rates the United States overall 'Do Not Travel' for transgender visitors following the 2025 federal rollbacks.

NOTE: page content did not load at fetch time (only the equality-map site's navigation shell was retrieved); the underlying MAP Equality Map page tracks state-by-state bans on transgender people using public bathrooms and facilities according to their gender identity.
